content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Murfreesboro

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours. Critically, no prior work experience is required—making CAPM ideal for career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Murfreesboro's growing project-driven sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format compresses training into a focused schedule, allowing you to meet PMI's education requirement without lengthy part-time commitments while balancing your current role.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your CAPM application, documenting your secondary degree and completed education hours. Pay the associated exam fee to activate your eligibility window and secure your seat for the certification exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study guides aligned to PMI's CAPM Job Analysis. Schedule your exam at a Prometric testing center and demonstrate your project management knowledge to earn the credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or professional involvement to keep your certification active and demonstrate ongoing competency to employers.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
